arguments.sql: SELECT CASE strftime('%w', date) WHEN '0' THEN 'Sunday' WHEN '1' THEN 'Monday' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN '3' THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN '4' THEN 'Thursday' WHEN '5' THEN 'Friday' WHEN '6' THEN 'Saturday' END AS day_of_week, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions GROUP BY strftime('%w', date) ORDER BY CAST(strftime('%w', date) AS INTEGER)
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions by day of the week, listed from Sunday through Saturday.
assumptions: All transactions are counted, including those without a fraud label.
Day of week is taken from the transaction date (2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31), with Sunday listed first.
Negative-amount transactions are included, since the question asks about transactions in general.
